name: calculate_var
description: Calculate parametric Value-at-Risk (variance-covariance method) for a portfolio at a confidence level over a time horizon. Returns VaR at 90/95/99% levels with plain-language interpretation.

time_horizon_days.description: Trading days for the VaR horizon (1=daily, 10=two weeks) (Default: 1)

annual_volatility.description: Annualized portfolio volatility as decimal, e.g. 0.18 (Default: 0.18)

name: stress_test_portfolio
description: Stress-test a portfolio against historical crisis scenarios (2008 crisis, COVID crash, dot-com bubble, Black Monday, rate shock) and report estimated losses and recovery times.

scenario.description: One of: 2008_financial_crisis, covid_crash_2020, dot_com_bubble, black_monday_1987, interest_rate_shock, all; Default: all

name: analyze_portfolio_risk
description: Analyze risk for a set of positions: per-position beta and volatility, portfolio beta, portfolio volatility, and concentration metrics. Provide positions as a JSON array like [{"symbol": "AAPL", "value": 50000}].

name: monte_carlo_simulation
description: Run a Monte Carlo (geometric Brownian motion) simulation of portfolio value over N years. Returns percentile outcomes, probability of loss, and probability of doubling.

annual_return.description: Expected annual return as decimal, e.g. 0.08 (Default: 0.08)

annual_volatility.description: Expected annual volatility as decimal, e.g. 0.15 (Default: 0.15)
